about: In-game English names of parts, keyed by model file. Sources: the game's own 2018 item data (github.com/Zicore/CrossoutMarket), Crossout fan sites (crosscalc.net: names, and each part's render compared with its in-game icon), and in-game checks. 'folders' titles folders that hold several different parts. Parts not listed show their file name; users can name any part themselves (saved in settings).
